messages.en:

The {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00} starts

{07 15 00}Expect me to be the victor
in this great flowery
battle, my friend!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} How's the
gardening going,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 15 00}Sunday's the last day!
So just keep that in mind
when you're losing, loser!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kuidas
aiandus edeneb,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 15 00}Pühapäev on viimane päev!
Pea seda meeles, kui sa
kaotad, kaotaja!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Guys like me aren't really
supposed to be into
gardening.
{07 14 00}But once you start, I guess
it's not all that awful,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Minusugused mehed ei
peaks õieti aiandusest
vaimustuma.
{07 14 00}Aga kui juba alustad, siis
pole see vist nii hull,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I don't really know how
flower choice affects your
chances of winning.
So I figure I'll just plant
like crazy and see what
happens, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma ei tea õieti, kuidas
lillede valik mõjutab su
võiduvõimalusi.
Nii et ma istutan lihtsalt
nagu hull ja vaatan, mis
juhtub, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}We're about halfway into
the {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
I wasn't into it at first,
but now I love taking care
of my little flower friends!
.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Uhh, {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0f 00}let's just pretend I
didn't say that, OK?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Oleme umbes poole peal
{ff 00 00 03}lillepeost{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Alguses ma ei vaimustunud,
aga nüüd meeldib mulle oma
lillekesi hooldada!
.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Ee, {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0f 00}teeme nägu, et ma

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Flower Fest{ff 00 00 00} ends next
Sunday! {07 15 00}But I won't be beat,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I'm gonna scream insults at
these flowers until they
bloom!

Ma karjun neile lilledele

õitsevad!

trapid on natuke

messages.en:
{07 19 00}A flower for a true man{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.


{07 00 00}{01 04 00}You know those flowers in
the jungle that smell
like rotting meat?{01 05 00}

real men, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}Lill tõelisele mehele{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

mis haisevad nagu
mädanev liha?{01 05 00}

meestele, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}A manly flower{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.


{07 00 00}{01 04 00}How 'bout the Daisy Cutter!

bomb that flattens flowers!

itself, but boy is it manly!{01 00 00 05 00}{01 05 00}
